dataset: Real GAD-7 questionnaire (776 rows, Figshare CC BY) — label = GAD-7 total >=10 (moderate+). Label is derived from the items BY DESIGN (mirrors the clinical rule the app uses), so an EXPECTED_LEAKAGE_LABEL_FROM_FEATURES flag is expected.
known_limitations: App-aligned projection of a real public dataset (ml/data/README.md) — not a local clinical sample; revalidate on local data before clinical use
All app features are present in the source dataset
Screening and awareness tool only, not a diagnostic device

RULE_EQUIVALENT_MODEL: the label is derived from these very features by design (PHQ-9/GAD-7 item sum >= 10), so the 'model' is mathematically the clinical rule. It is trained for back-compatibility but is NOT an accuracy claim — the app serves the rule directly (status RULE_SERVED).
